scripts.build: npm run build -w @eda-debugger/core && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventemitter && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventtarget && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/cloud
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventemitter && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventtarget && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cloud && tsc --noEmit -p apps/viewer && tsc --noEmit -p apps/demo && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run sim -w @eda-debugger/demo && npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/viewer
scripts.demo:live: npm run build && npm run live -w @eda-debugger/demo
scripts.server: npm run build -w @eda-debugger/core && npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/server
